digest.component_or_area: LLM verdict signing and provider attribution
propositions: Signed LLM verdicts currently record only model string and cannot distinguish between provider backends (Anthropic, Bedrock, Ollama) or tier (first-class vs best-effort)

A new additive provider_provenance object must be stamped into verdicts carrying provider name, endpoint host (credentials-free), tier, and effective capabilities record, without invalidating existing signatures
The provenance record must be assembled once per run in runner.py from already-computed fields and reused by all three sidecars (plan_review, completion, code_review), never recomputed

Production gate verdicts require wiring of provider_provenance from the verify step outputs through finalize_verdict to the sidecar payload, with graceful None defaults for offline tests and non-LLM paths
Endpoint host extraction must use urlparse().hostname to strip userinfo, and the persisted payload must be asserted to contain no credential material from base_url or api_key
Story 2932 (supports_temperature field) must land first to complete the capabilities record shape before provenance signs it for the first time
